source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    To check BMC dedicate port power on status is normal.
1. Power on system
2. Connect RJ45 cable to port
3. Check RJ45 LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check RJ45 LED if soild green as system spec

original_test_intent: Verify that the dedicated BMC RJ45 port presents the platform-specified solid-green indication after the SUT is powered and an approved cable is connected.
original_method: An engineer powers on the SUT, connects the approved cable and peer to the identified dedicated management port, then visually observes and photographs the port LED against the platform specification.
manual_activity: The core acceptance is a physical LED colour/state observation after power-on and cable insertion. An engineer must identify the connector, make the physical connection and record the LED; link telemetry cannot substitute for this observation.
required_inputs: Exact motherboard revision and dedicated BMC-port designator
Authoritative meaning and timing of the required solid-green LED
Approved cable, peer/switch port, network isolation and final cable state
Power-on authorization, physical operator and OOB recovery path
safety_requirements: Do not power or cable a production system outside the approved maintenance plan.
Do not infer the dedicated port from connector appearance or an OS interface name.
Do not disconnect an active management link or attach the port to an unapproved network.
Stop on ambiguous LED semantics, wrong-port risk or loss of management access; preserve evidence and do not retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Capture read-only power, BMC reachability, interface/link and SEL state before and after the operator action.
Prepare a timestamped LED photo checklist and correlate operator evidence with telemetry.
Report the link/tool result separately without claiming the LED was observed by the agent.
engineer_actions: Approve power, cable, peer and management-impact plan.
Power the SUT, connect the cable and visually record the identified port LED.
Interpret the solid-green indication under the platform specification and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects remote execution of the LED observation; its description of the LED as link activity must remain conditional on the platform specification.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use documented read-only BMC or switch-port link telemetry only as supporting correlation. Do not substitute it for the source's visual LED criterion.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Power-on, cable connection, solid-green visual criterion and 1/0-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN VISUAL LED CHECK WITH TELEMETRY CORRELATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Identify the port from the board drawing, use an approved peer, timestamp the physical LED photo after the specified stabilization interval and correlate it with read-only BMC/switch link state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact motherboard/BMC port and approved network peer.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board/BMC firmware and peer model/configuration.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner platform LED table, motherboard drawing and network topology.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable identity, peer and telemetry traceability; the visual criterion remains primary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; no traffic-throughput or speed coverage is inferred.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Link-up telemetry may not encode LED colour or steady/blinking behaviour.

project_override_considerations: The project may define the approved peer, stabilization time and exact LED interpretation. Missing values make execution not ready, not permanently blocked. A reachability-only override would reduce coverage and must be explicitly approved as a different method.
expected_evidence: Board, port, LED specification and approved peer/cable identities
Timestamped photo or operator record showing the solid-green state
Correlated power/link status and unexpected-log review
Restored/approved final cabling, BMC reachability and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criterion consistently require physical cable connection and a solid-green dedicated-port LED under the system specification.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual method is understandable. Missing platform LED and peer details are project readiness inputs, not a permanent semantic blocker.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with human-only LED observation but add identity and network-change controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and retain its cable/peer, OOB and evidence requirements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly separates the visual acceptance result from supporting electronic link status and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a generic link-up result or the wrong RJ45 connector from being accepted as proof of the specified dedicated-port LED state.
independent_technical_reasoning: The visible colour and steady-state pattern are the stated acceptance object. Although power/link telemetry can be collected automatically, it cannot establish what the engineer sees at the connector, so the case remains MANUAL ONLY.
